issues.rootCause: One required source role is absent from inventory.
issues.minimalFix: Acquire or restore the missing source PDF before staging.

issues.rootCause: Multiple physical PDF paths map to the same canonical role identity.
issues.minimalFix: Remove or relocate the duplicate in a separate asset-cleanup change after hash verification.
issues.regressionRisk: Reporting ambiguity only; canonical pair remains discoverable.
